# netactuate_cloud_routing_router_vrf_bgp_neighbors (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Routing Router VRF BGP Neighbors visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_routing_router_vrf_bgp_neighbors" "example" {
  router_id = 12345
  vrf_id    = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) Cloud router ID.
- `vrf_id` (Number) VRF ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `neighbors` (List of Object) BGP neighbors configured in the VRF. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--neighbors))

<a id="nestedatt--neighbors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `neighbors`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `ipv4_enabled` (Boolean)
- `ipv6_enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_shutdown` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `neighbor_id` (Number)
- `remote_asn` (Number)
- `source_address` (String)
